name: tana-tasks
description: Orbital: an outliner over your Tana documents, kept live over Tana's platform sync

scripts.check: node scripts/platform-check.js --self && node scripts/db-check.js && node scripts/sdk-check.js && node scripts/renderer-check.js && node scripts/renderer-behavior-check.js && node scripts/updater-check.js && node scripts/pdf-check.js && node scripts/livequery-check.js && node scripts/presence-check.js && node scripts/ios-engine-check.js && node scripts/phone-model-check.js && node scripts/glyph-check.js && node scripts/relay-check.js
scripts.postinstall: node node_modules/electron/install.js && (sh -c "plutil -replace CFBundleName -string Orbital node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info.plist && plutil -replace CFBundleDisplayName -string Orbital node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info.plist && plutil -replace CFBundleIdentifier -string com.dreetje.orbital.dev node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info.plist && cp build/icon.icns node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Resources/electron.icns && codesign --force --deep --sign - node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app" || true)
